risks.title: Permanent dispatch/result rejects are consumed with no DLQ artifact or metric

No ORDER_FAILED/failure projection; Orders cannot distinguish running from failed
Reader POST has no request-level idempotency; retry creates a second order/workId
Profile expiresAt/effective_status is ignored at reader/ingress
Ingress prefers userId over ownerUserId; queue ARN pin can be skipped when env is absent (entitlement resolver now fails closed)
Secret shape not enforced; rotation JSON silently fails all signatures (permanent rejects, no DLQ)
Cross-tenant profile/entitlement integrity and duplicate-workId owner reuse need enforcement
Worker role is shared and broad; dispatch path lacks subject-fence/erasure parity
No DLQ replay path/break-glass grant; worker ESM lacks partial batch response; no ingress concurrency cap
Optional hardening: log scope, CMK dead variable, visibility ratio, dummy agents in prod, table default
